unknown.notes: No form-factor claim is made without an explicit class hint or future trusted hardware evidence.

laptop.notes: Planning hints do not prove a battery, camera, microphone, sensor, or accelerator exists.

desktop.notes: Sustained compute remains subject to NodeSeed/Yard capacity evidence and policy.

phone.notes: The class does not imply camera, microphone, GPS, secure element, telephony, or sensor permission.

tablet.notes: Hardware and permission claims require separate evidence.

server.notes: Continuous residency and compute capacity still require runtime evidence.
